Covers all the figures except Figure 1 (see `02_figure_1_community.Rmd`):

* MAG summary table
* Supplementary Figure 1 – does pN/pS or θN/θS depend on coverage?
* Figure 2 – θN/θS at 3 vs 25 cmbsf, split by MAG lifestyle
* Figure 3 – θN/θS against θS (a proxy for effective population size) at each depth,
  regressions, bootstrapped slopes and the implied distribution of fitness effects
* Table of the genes with the highest θN/θS at 25 cmbsf
* Core vs accessory genes and their selection regime
* Figure 4 – gene coverage across depth relative to BUSCO genes

Inputs are the tables in `data/intermediate/`, produced by `01_make_gene_dataframes.Rmd`
(pre-computed copies are shipped, so this notebook runs on its own).

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt) #seems to be the best table library unless you need it as an image in which case ggpubr::ggtexttable
library(colorspace)
library(gganimate) # transition_states() in the DFE animations
library(here)      # here() builds paths from the project root, wherever the project is unpacked

data_dir <- here("data")
```

## Per-gene population genetics tables

These two are generated in `01_make_gene_dataframes.Rmd`: one row per gene and read depth
(`reads_source`, cmbsf) with πN/πS, θN/θS, pN/pS, annotations, BUSCO flag and MAG lifestyle.
Scaffold contig_4729 (in M5_3.252) is removed because its coverage as a whole is very depth
sensitive.

```{r}
popgen_plus_anno_m5 <- read_delim(file.path(data_dir, "intermediate/MAG_popgen_plus_anno_M5.tsv.gz")) %>% mutate(scaffold = str_extract(gene, "contig_[0-9]+")) %>% filter(MAG != "M5_3.64.filtered.fa", scaffold != "contig_4729")
popgen_plus_anno_m1 <- read_delim(file.path(data_dir, "intermediate/MAG_popgen_plus_anno_M1.tsv.gz")) %>% mutate(scaffold = str_extract(gene, "contig_[0-9]+"))
```

versions of the same figure.

```{r}
generate_hex_plot_theta_separate_sites <- function(plot_site, plot_lifestyle, plot_palette, plot_title, plot_df){
  ph = sequential_hcl(2, palette=plot_palette)[1] # grab the high and low colors from the colorspace library
  pl = sequential_hcl(2, palette=plot_palette)[2]
  return(#there is 0 need to save this object inside the function
    plot_df %>%
      filter((lifestyle == plot_lifestyle) & (site == plot_site)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x=theta_NS_25, y=theta_NS_3)) +
        geom_hex() +
        labs(x="\u03B8N/\u03B8S 25 CmBSF", y="\u03B8N/\u03B8S 3 CmBSF",title=plot_title) +
        xlim(0,1) +
        ylim(0,1) +
        coord_fixed() + 
        geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, color="black",linewidth=1, linetype="dotted") +
        scale_fill_continuous(high=ph,low=pl) +# setting the color with aes fill would set each hex the same and remove density info
        theme_bw() + 
        theme(text=element_text(family="Helvetica", size=22))
  )
}
```

```{r}
generate_hex_plot_theta <- function(plot_lifestyle, plot_palette, plot_title, plot_df){
  ph = sequential_hcl(2, palette=plot_palette)[1] # grab the high and low colors from the colorspace library
  pl = sequential_hcl(2, palette=plot_palette)[2]
  return(#there is 0 need to save this object inside the function
    plot_df %>%
      filter((lifestyle == plot_lifestyle) ) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x=theta_NS_25, y=theta_NS_3)) +
        geom_hex() +
        labs(x="\u03B8N/\u03B8S 25 CmBSF", y="\u03B8N/\u03B8S 3 CmBSF",title=plot_title) +
        xlim(0,1) +
        ylim(0,1) +
        coord_fixed() + 
        geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, color="black",linewidth=1, linetype="dotted") +

}
```

## Figure 3 – θN/θS vs θS (selection efficacy vs population size)

Per MAG and read depth, average ln θS (a proxy for effective population size) and ln θN/θS.
To avoid the spurious negative correlation from θS appearing on both axes, θS is averaged
over the even-numbered genes on each contig and θN/θS over the odd-numbered genes.
Only genes with > 5x coverage and at least one synonymous variant are used.

```{r}
all_depths_pi_n_pi_s <- rbind(popgen_plus_anno_m5 %>% mutate(site = "M5"), popgen_plus_anno_m1 %>% mutate(site = "M1") )
all_depths_pi_s <- all_depths_pi_n_pi_s %>%
  group_by(MAG, reads_source, lifestyle) %>%
      mutate(number = as.integer(str_extract(gene, "(?<=_)[0-9]+$"))) %>%
      filter(coverage > 5) %>%
      filter((number %% 2 ) == 0) %>% #even numbered starts -> theta-hat S, odd numbered starts -> theta-hat NS
  mutate(
    cn_p_N = n_variants_N / (Ln * coverage), # coverage normalized pN
    cn_p_S = n_variants_S / (Ls * coverage)
    ) %>%
  mutate(
    cn_p_NS = cn_p_N / cn_p_S
  ) %>% 
  filter(
    (n_variants_S > 0) & (!is.na(n_variants_N)) & (pi_S > 0) & (theta_S > 0) & !is.infinite(theta_S) & (coverage > 5)
    ) %>%
  group_by(MAG, reads_source, site) %>% 
  summarise(
#    ln_pi_ns = mean(log(pi_NS + 0.0001)),
    ln_pi_s = mean(log(pi_S)),
 #   ln_theta_ns = mean(log(theta_NS+ 0.0001)),
    ln_theta_s = mean(log(theta_S)),
    ln_theta_s_sd = sd(log(theta_S)),
  #  ln_p_ns = mean(log(p_NS+ 0.0001)),
    ln_p_s = mean(log(p_S)),
  #  ln_cn_p_ns = mean(log(cn_p_NS+ 0.0001)),
    ln_cn_p_s = mean(log(cn_p_S)),
    coverage = mean(coverage),
    n_s = n()
  )
all_depths_pi_ns <- all_depths_pi_n_pi_s %>%
  group_by(MAG, reads_source, lifestyle) %>%
      mutate(number = as.integer(str_extract(gene, "(?<=_)[0-9]+$"))) %>%
      filter(coverage > 5) %>%
      filter((number %% 2 ) != 0) %>% #even numbered starts -> theta-hat S, odd numbered starts -> theta-hat NS
  mutate(
    cn_p_N = n_variants_N / (Ln * coverage), # coverage normalized pN
    cn_p_S = n_variants_S / (Ls * coverage)
    ) %>%
  mutate(
    cn_p_NS = cn_p_N / cn_p_S
  ) %>% 
  filter(
    (n_variants_S > 0) & (!is.na(n_variants_N)) & (pi_S > 0) & (theta_S > 0) & !is.infinite(theta_S) & (coverage > 5)
    ) %>%
  group_by(MAG, reads_source, site) %>% 
  summarise(
    ln_pi_ns = mean(log(pi_NS + 0.0001)),
#    ln_pi_s = mean(log(pi_S)),
    ln_theta_ns = mean(log(theta_NS+ 0.0001)),
    ln_theta_ns_sd = sd(log(theta_NS + 0.0001)),
 #   ln_theta_s = mean(log(theta_S)),
    ln_p_ns = mean(log(p_NS+ 0.0001)),
  #  ln_p_s = mean(log(p_S)),
    ln_cn_p_ns = mean(log(cn_p_NS+ 0.0001)),
  #  ln_cn_p_s = mean(log(cn_p_S)),
    n_ns = n()
  )
all_depths_pi_n_pi_s_summary <- left_join(all_depths_pi_s, all_depths_pi_ns) %>% mutate(n = n_s + n_ns)
```

### Bootstrapped regression slopes

Each MAG's mean ln θN/θS and ln θS is resampled from a normal distribution with the
across-gene SD, and the regression refitted 1000 times, to get the uncertainty of the
slope / intercept at each depth.

```{r}
# returns a data.frame of nrep_ (+1) bootstrapped slopes and intercepts for one site / depth
bootstrap_regs <- function(mean_NS, mean_S, NS_stds, S_stds, depth, site){
  nrep_ = 1000
  slopes = rep(NA, nrep_)
  intercepts = rep(NA, nrep_)
  l = length(mean_NS)
  temp_NS = rep(NA, l)
  temp_S = rep(NA, l)
  for(i in seq(1,1+nrep_)){
    df <- data.frame(NS = temp_NS, S = temp_S)
    for(j in seq(1:l)){
        df$NS[j] = rnorm(1,mean=mean_NS[j], sd=NS_stds[j])
        df$S[j] = rnorm(1,mean=mean_S[j], sd=S_stds[j])
    }
    m = lm(NS ~ S, data=df)
    slopes[i] = m$coefficients[[2]]
    intercepts[i] = m$coefficients[[1]]
  }
  values = data.frame(slope = slopes, intercept=intercepts,  depth=rep(depth,nrep_+1), site=rep(site,nrep_+1))
  return(values)
}



slope_df <- data.frame(slope=numeric(), intercept=numeric(), depth=integer(), site=character())

for (d in c(1,3,7,10,25)){
   for(s in c("M1","M5")){
     sub_df <- all_depths_pi_n_pi_s_summary %>% filter((site == s) & (reads_source == d))
     values = bootstrap_regs(sub_df$ln_theta_ns, sub_df$ln_theta_s, sub_df$ln_theta_ns_sd, sub_df$ln_theta_s_sd, d, s)
     slope_df <- rbind(slope_df, values)
   } 
}
```

### Implied distribution of fitness effects (DFE)

The |slope| and |intercept| of the θN/θS ~ θS regression are used as the shape and scale
of a gamma-distributed DFE, from which selection coefficients are simulated.

```{r}
simulated_dfe_bs <- slope_df %>%
    group_by(depth, site) %>%
    summarise(mean_slope = mean(slope),sd_slope = sd(slope), mean_intercept = mean(intercept)) %>%
  group_by(depth, site) %>%
  reframe(s = -rgamma(1000,shape=abs(first(mean_slope)), scale=abs(first(mean_intercept)))) %>% filter(s >= -1)

simulated_dfe_bs %>% ggplot(aes(x=s, fill=factor(depth))) + geom_histogram(binwidth=0.01)  + facet_grid(site ~ depth, scales="free") + labs(x="selection coefficient", fill="CmBSF")
```





```{r}
slope_bs_summary <- slope_df %>%
    group_by(depth, site) %>%
    summarise(mean_slope = mean(slope),sd_slope = sd(slope), mean_intercept = mean(intercept)) %>% ungroup()
distro = data.frame()
for (i in seq(length(slope_bs_summary$mean_slope))){
  distro <- rbind(distro, data.frame(vals = rgamma(10000, shape=abs(slope_bs_summary$mean_slope[i]), scale=abs(slope_bs_summary$mean_intercept[i])), site = slope_bs_summary$site[i], depth = slope_bs_summary$depth[i]) )
}
```

Animated versions, stepping through the depths (rendered with gganimate; needs the `gifski` package):

```{r}
distro %>% ggplot(aes(x=-vals, fill=factor(depth))) + geom_histogram(binwidth=0.01) + labs(x="selection coefficient", fill="Depth (Cm)") + xlim(-1,0) + scale_color_manual(values=c("#E16A86", "#AA9000", "#00AA5A", "#00A6CA", "#B675E0")) + facet_wrap(~site) +ylim(0,800) + theme_bw() + transition_states(depth, transition_length = 1, state_length = 2) 
```

```{r}
distro %>% ggplot(aes(x=-vals, fill=factor(depth))) + geom_density() + labs(x="selection coefficient", fill="Depth (Cm)") + xlim(-1,0) + scale_color_manual(values=c("#E16A86", "#AA9000", "#00AA5A", "#00A6CA", "#B675E0")) + facet_wrap(~site)+ylim(0,800) + theme_bw() + transition_states(depth, transition_length = 1, state_length = 2) 
```

## Table – annotated genes with the highest θN/θS at 25 cmbsf

Top 20 genes (both sites) with a UniRef90 or PHROG annotation, plus their best mobileOG hit
(mobile genetic element database).

```{r}
left_join(
  left_join(
    rbind(
      popgen_plus_anno_m5 %>% mutate(site = "M5"),
      popgen_plus_anno_m1 %>% mutate(site = "M1")
      ),
    mag_table %>% mutate(genome = str_extract(MAG, "M[15]_3.[0-9]+")) %>% select(genome, Family, Genus)
    ),
    read_delim(file.path(data_dir, "annotations/mobileOG_annotations_M1_M5.tsv.gz")) %>%
      select(gene, `mobileOG Entry Name`, `Major mobileOG Category`,`Minor mobileOG Categories`,evalue) %>%
      rename(mobileOG = `mobileOG Entry Name`) %>% 
      filter(!is.na(`Major mobileOG Category`)) %>%
      group_by(gene) %>%
      slice_min(evalue, n=1, with_ties = F)
  ) %>%
  filter(reads_source == 25) %>%
  filter(!is.na(From) | !is.na(Phrog)) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = theta_NS, n=20, with_ties =F) %>%
  mutate(genome = str_extract(MAG, "M[15]_[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")) %>% 
  select(gene, genome, Family, Genus, gene_length, coverage, sites_N, sites_S, theta_NS, From, `Gene Names_uniref`, `Protein names`, mobileOG, `Major mobileOG Category` ) %>% 
  rename(PSN = sites_N, PSS = sites_S, `tN/tS` = theta_NS, Uniref90 = From, `Gene names` =`Gene Names_uniref`, `length (nt)` = gene_length)  %>%
  gt() %>%
  opt_stylize( style = 2, color = "gray", add_row_striping = TRUE) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "PSN: Polymorphic Sites Non-synonymous, PSS: Polymorphic Sites Synonymous",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = c("PSS","PSN"))
    ) %>% opt_stylize( style = 2, color = "gray", add_row_striping = TRUE)
```


## Core vs accessory genes and their selection regime (M5)

A gene is called "core" if its coverage across depths tracks the MAG's mean BUSCO coverage
(bmc) with Pearson r ≥ 0.75, otherwise "accessory". The θN/θS cut-offs for Purifying /
Neutral / Positive (0.843 and 1.377) are the bootstrapped neutral range from
`01_make_gene_dataframes.Rmd`.

```{r}
# mean BUSCO-gene coverage per MAG and depth
bmcs <-  popgen_plus_anno_m5 %>% filter(is_busco) %>% group_by(MAG, reads_source) %>% summarise(bmc = mean(coverage, na.rm=T)) %>% ungroup()
gene_corr_coefs <- left_join(
  popgen_plus_anno_m5 %>%
    select(MAG, gene, reads_source, coverage, is_busco) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols=c("MAG","gene","is_busco"),
      names_from=reads_source,
      values_from=c(coverage),
      names_prefix = "coverage_") %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols=starts_with("coverage_"),
      names_to="reads_source",
      values_to = "coverage") %>%
    mutate(
      coverage = ifelse(is.na(coverage),0,coverage),
      reads_source=as.integer(gsub("coverage_","",reads_source))),
  bmcs) %>%
  group_by(MAG, gene) %>%
  #slice_head(n=10)
  summarise(corr = cor(coverage, bmc), covg_var = var(coverage / bmc))

head(gene_corr_coefs)
```


```{r}
core_acc_evol_table <- left_join(
  popgen_plus_anno_m5 %>%
    select(genome, reads_source, gene,  theta_NS) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = reads_source, values_from = theta_NS) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = where(is.numeric), names_to = "reads_source", values_to = "theta_NS"),
  gene_corr_coefs) %>%
  filter(MAG %in% c("M5_3.3.filtered.fa","M5_3.252.filtered.fa","M5_3.68.filtered.fa")) %>%
  mutate(pang_status = ifelse(corr >= 0.75, "Core", "Acc.")) %>% #pangenome status
  mutate(evol_status = ifelse(is.na(theta_NS), "NA", ifelse(theta_NS < 0.843, "Purifying", ifelse(theta_NS < 1.377, "Neutral", "Positive")))) %>%
  group_by(genome, pang_status, evol_status, reads_source) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() 
core_acc_evol_table %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from=n, names_from = c(pang_status, evol_status))
```
```{r}
#double check we have the same number of genes in core/acc through the core
core_acc_evol_table %>%
    pivot_wider(values_from=n, names_from = c(pang_status, evol_status)) %>% group_by(genome, reads_source) %>% summarise(acc = rowSums(across(starts_with("Acc"))), core = rowSums(across(starts_with("Core"))))
```
```{r}
core_acc_evol_table %>%
    pivot_wider(values_from=n, names_from = c(pang_status, evol_status)) %>%
  group_by(genome, reads_source) %>%
  summarise(
    acc_purif_frac = `Acc._Purifying` / (`Acc._Neutral` + `Acc._Purifying` + `Acc._Positive`),
    core_purif_frac = Core_Purifying / (Core_Neutral + Core_Purifying + Core_Positive)
    )
```

```{r}
ggpubr::ggtexttable(core_acc_evol_table %>%
                      rename(CmBSF = reads_source) %>%
                      pivot_wider(values_from=n, names_from = c(pang_status, evol_status), names_sep = " ") ,
 theme=ggpubr::ttheme("lBlackWhite"), rows=NULL)

```




## Figure 4 – environmentally sensitive genes

Determine what genes are environmentally sensitive (this is here because it's imperative it uses the same popgen_plus_anno df that the other analyses do)

Genes are grouped into clusters (MMseqs2, 50 % amino-acid identity). For each gene the
coverage at each depth is expressed relative to its MAG's mean BUSCO coverage
(log10 fold change), and a linear model per cluster tests whether that relative coverage
differs between the bioturbated zone (BT, < 7 cmbsf) and the deeper sediment (SRZ, ≥ 7 cmbsf).
Shown for the three focal M5 MAGs (M5_3.3, M5_3.252, M5_3.68).

```{r}
clusters_M5 <- read_delim(file.path(data_dir, "all_depths_M5_3/clustered_aaai50_cluster.tsv.gz"),col_names = c("cluster_rep","cluster_member"),delim="\t")
clusters_M5 <- clusters_M5 %>% group_by(cluster_rep) %>% mutate(cluster_number = cur_group_id())

ppa_m5_clusters <- left_join(popgen_plus_anno_m5, clusters_M5 %>% select(cluster_member, cluster_number), join_by(gene == cluster_member))

ppa_m5_clusters <- ppa_m5_clusters %>%
  select(MAG, gene, cluster_number, is_busco, coverage, reads_source) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from=coverage, names_from = reads_source,names_prefix="coverage_") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols=starts_with("coverage"),names_to = "reads_source",values_to="coverage",names_prefix="coverage_",values_drop_na = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(coverage = ifelse(is.na(coverage), 0, coverage)) 
busco_MAG_avg_M5 <- ppa_m5_clusters %>% filter(is_busco) %>%  group_by(MAG, reads_source) %>% summarise(n = n(), bmc = mean(coverage, na.rm=T))


ppa_m5_clusters <- left_join(ppa_m5_clusters, busco_MAG_avg_M5, join_by(MAG, reads_source)) %>%
  filter(MAG %in% c("M5_3.3.filtered.fa","M5_3.252.filtered.fa","M5_3.68.filtered.fa")) %>%
  mutate(reads_source = as.integer(reads_source)) %>%
  mutate(log10_fold_change = log10((coverage + 0.001) / bmc)) %>%
  mutate(envt = factor(ifelse(reads_source < 7, "BT","SRZ"))) #here I define an environment, other versions of this analysis have done a regression based on log10 CmBSF

reg_df_m5 <- ppa_m5_clusters %>%
  group_by(cluster_number) %>%
  reframe(
    linear_model_summary = summary(lm(log10_fold_change ~ envt))[["coefficients"]][2,]
  )

reg_df_m5$value_name = rep(c("coef","SE","t_val","p_val"),length(reg_df_m5$cluster_number)/4)

reg_df_m5 <- reg_df_m5 %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = linear_model_summary, names_from = value_name) 

ppa_m5_clusters <- left_join(ppa_m5_clusters, reg_df_m5, join_by(cluster_number)) %>% filter(MAG %in% c("M5_3.3.filtered.fa","M5_3.252.filtered.fa","M5_3.68.filtered.fa"))
```

Heatmap of relative coverage per gene and depth, genes ordered by their relative coverage at 25 cmbsf:

```{r}
gene_levels <- (ppa_m5_clusters %>%
  select(reads_source, gene, MAG, log10_fold_change) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(gene, MAG), names_from = reads_source, values_from = log10_fold_change, names_prefix="rel_freq_") %>%
  arrange(rel_freq_25))$gene

m5_gene_heatmap <- ppa_m5_clusters %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=factor(reads_source), y=factor(gene, levels=gene_levels), fill=log10_fold_change)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~MAG, ncol=2, scales="free_y") + 
  colorspace::scale_fill_binned_diverging(palette = "Tropic") +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), text=element_text(family="Helvetica", size=22))+
  labs(x = "CmBSF", fill="Relative frequency", y = "gene") 
m5_gene_heatmap
```
